title: Three Demons vs Three Saints
summary: At Yaochi, Ye Fan gets Nannan back, and holy lords including the Wanchu Holy Lord's younger brother Ou Luotian (Immortal Platform 2nd level) and holy-land leader Wang Zheng (Immortal Platform) demand his death for the Dragon Nest deaths. Ye Fan plays a record showing they forced him to lead them in against his warnings. The Queen Mother of the West won't openly take sides, and then the Peacock King, the Red Dragon Daoist and the Crow Daoist (Immortal Platform) arrive to protect him. On Yaochi's ancient Life-and-Death Stage, the Peacock King kills Ou Yetian in two moves and then fights Wang Zheng's Hunyuan Holy Light Art and chaos-stone seal. The Red Dragon Daoist takes over and beats Wang Zheng with the Eight Heavenly Arts, and the Crow Daoist crushes a Yin-Yang elder's imitation Yin-Yang mirror with his Fire Domain. When 'Leader Wang' vows to burn all his cultivation to activate a holy weapon, the Queen Mother suppresses him with the Xihuang Pagoda. Far away, an ancient Supreme watches from the Ancient Road Cliff.
